description: Parity ledger contract for the bundled-vs-hub answer-leg engine request (specs/artifacts/planning/engine-parity-instrument.md AC-3). Every JSON-path difference between the two captured requests must be listed here with a reason, or the diff fails. Shrinking this list is the refactoring driver.

documented_retrieval_divergence.reason: Both arms implement the contracted context_policy concepts against the SAME querystore index, with different mechanisms (bundled buildScoped: typed-complete slices + similarity top-K + 15-record temporal-gated recency anchor; hub: mandatory core + exact/overlap ranking + 32-record always-on clinical-date recency core + token budget). Measured 2026-07-22 (system-prompt format examples excluded): 27v36, 27v41, 36v78, 42v70 records. The one invariant gap: hub always includes the mandatory clinical core (allergies + active conditions, fixture context.enumerated-medications-are-complete mandatory_ids) — bundled includes it only when the intent scopes it. DELETE this entry when the bundled context_policy conformance adapter lands and buildScoped satisfies the shared fixtures (mandatory inclusion + recency anchor); the retrieval gate then becomes invariant-based.
